company.description:
BitOasis is a cryptocurrency trading platform offering a digital asset wallet and exchange to buy, sell, and trade. Its multi-signature wallet and exchange service focus on cash-based emerging markets that enable enterprises to protect their assets while adding an extra layer of security.

The company was co-founded in 2015 by Ola Doudin and Daniel Robenek.

productsAndServices.description: A platform for buying, selling, and trading cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, through a digital asset wallet and exchange.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,671,420 to $169,384,551, a 36.26x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 48 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 53 (+3).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
